proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell latency-bound kernels with DRAM headroom (fixable via more in-flight loads and higher occupancy) from truly bandwidth-saturated ones (only fewer bytes help), because no stall-reason or achieved-occupancy counter is measured.

rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH with DRAM<80% -> latency-bound: add ILP, wider vectorized loads, raise occupancy; HIGH with DRAM>85% -> bandwidth-bound: only reduce bytes (dtype, re-reads, fusion); LOW -> leave the memory path alone and check issue/launch overhead
rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: LOW -> occupancy limits latency hiding: cut registers per thread and retune block size/num_warps first; HIGH -> occupancy is fine: increase per-thread ILP or reduce traffic instead of restructuring the launch
